review.obligations: For every original PrimitiveCuspForm Q k with k at least two and prime p greater than three, construct the actual finite local coefficient field, residue characteristic p and original coefficient embedding, then a continuous representation of the original rational absolute Galois group in GL2 of that field. Every original good-prime norm Frobenius has exactly the original Fourier coefficient as trace and q^(k-1) as determinant. Actual complex conjugation has trace zero and determinant minus one. The group action, rank-two basis, spanning trace algebra, matrix continuity, oddness and Frobenius values are derived, not supplied.
review.remaining: The new matrices still need the full required original unramified/local/image/regularity association bridges. Primes two and three, full original all-weight association, automorphy and literal higher symmetric-power continuation remain required. Acceptance remains 16/20 and DUB-17--20 OPEN. Focused compilation does not replace the exhaustive audits or subsequent assembled verification.
